newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Great Southern Energy buys gas co.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Great Southern Energy buys gas co.

text.p: New South Wales electricity distributor Great Southern Energy said on Tuesday it had acquired the natural gas business of the Wagga Wagga City Council in the south of the state for A$56 million.
Great Southern chief executive Brian Burton said the purchase would give the company a broader base and opportunities to expand in a deregulated energy market.
"As a dual-energy provider, Great Southern Energy can now offer total energy packages - a one-stop shop for customers' energy needs," Burton said in a statement.
The Wagga Wagga business includes a 525-km gas reticulation system serving 13,500 customers, land and buildings, plant and equipment, existing contracts and technical data.
Great Southern, one of six electricity distributors owned by the New South Wales state government, currently supplies electricity to 220,000 customers.
Other parties which had expressed interest in the Wagga Wagga business included the Australian Gas Light Co, Boral Ltd unit Boral Energy Resources Ltd, and Texas-based Texas Utilities Co.

The New South Wales government said last week it would examine the feasibility of a proposal by Pacific Power Ltd and Great Southern Energy to build an A$85 million gas-fired power plant in Wagga Wagga.
